title: Detective Conan
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Teen detective Shinichi Kudo is poisoned by members of a crime syndicate, the Black Organization, and shrinks into a child's body. Calling himself Conan Edogawa, he lives with his childhood friend Ran and her father, the bumbling private detective Kogoro Mori, secretly solving case after case by tranquilizing Kogoro and speaking through a voice-changer. The long-running series mixes standalone murder mysteries with the hunt for the Organization.
life_message: Truth must be found and told, and reason and justice should prevail over crime.
